P3 Solution Design Review Notes - 2026-05-02
Program: Core Banking AI Operating Model & Analytics Modernization
Phase: P3 Solution / Program Design
Attendees: Ethan Brooks, Priya Mehta, Lena Ortiz, Rachel Kim, Nadia Rahman, James Park, Kevin Walsh, enterprise architect, servicing operations lead.
Intent: approve target-state analytics operating model and requirements traceability before roadmap.
Decisions:
- Select product analytics operating model with governed core-banking/customer/account data product layer.
- Exclude core replacement execution; Programs owns strategy/readiness, Tower observes after handoff.
- Require model-risk governance checkpoint before P4 roadmap approval.
- Payments/fraud signal latency feed must be in Tower monitoring plan.
Requirements:
- R1 reduce request-to-insight cycle time.
- R2 improve lineage completeness for customer/account/product fields.
- R3 reduce payments/fraud signal latency.
- R4 reduce reopened analytics requests due to disputed definitions.
- R5 model-risk governance evidence visible before mobilization.
Outcomes:
- O1 faster digital banking product analytics delivery.
- O2 improved data trust for fraud and servicing signals.
- O3 fundable roadmap and mobilization package before execution outside AbarVa.
Sign-off:
- Priya Mehta approves target-state design for roadmap planning.
- Rachel Kim approves data-product direction.
- Nadia Rahman approves model-risk review path with one open item: evidence reproducibility check.
Actions:
- Lena to finalize traceability matrix.
- Rachel to confirm lineage feed mapping.
Risks:
- Program could drift into core replacement; maintain strict boundary.

P1 Discovery Workshop Notes - 2026-05-02
Program: Core Banking AI Operating Model & Analytics Modernization
Phase: P1 Discovery
Attendees: Ethan Brooks, Priya Mehta (Chief Product Officer sponsor), Lena Ortiz (program lead), Rachel Kim (data/product analytics), Nadia Rahman (risk/compliance), James Park (payments), Kevin Walsh (fraud operations), servicing operations lead.
Intent: validate analytics modernization baseline and define evidence needed before synthesis.
Decisions:
- Scope first cohort to digital banking product analytics, payments/fraud signal latency, servicing insight adoption, and core banking customer/account data lineage.
- Do not include core replacement execution in this program; execution happens outside AbarVa after P5 approval.
- Priya Mehta accepted weekly sponsor cadence through P2 and P3.
Baseline candidates:
- Analytics request-to-insight cycle time.
- Data lineage completeness for customer/account/product fields.
- Model deployment lead time.
- Payments/fraud signal latency.
- Servicing insight adoption rate.
- Rework rate caused by disputed data definitions.
Evidence captured:
- Product teams dispute customer/account joins between core banking, payments, and servicing.
- Fraud signal latency is treated as an operating risk and product-experience risk.
- Compliance wants model-risk governance and data lineage visible before P2 charter.
Actions:
- Rachel Kim to provide analytics cycle-time and lineage extract.
- James Park to provide payments/fraud signal latency sample.
- Kevin Walsh to provide fraud operations rework examples.
- Nadia Rahman to confirm model-risk governance entry criteria.
Risks:
- Program could drift into core replacement; keep it strategy-to-funding and roadmap only.
- Exact financial impact remains restricted.

P1 Baseline Attestation and Stakeholder Owner Addendum - 2026-05-02
Program: Core Banking AI Operating Model & Analytics Modernization
Phase: P1 Discovery
Attendees: Ethan Brooks, Priya Mehta, Lena Ortiz, Rachel Kim, Nadia Rahman, James Park, Kevin Walsh, servicing operations lead.
Sponsor decision:
- Priya Mehta approves PROCEED to P2 Synthesis once this addendum is saved with the Discovery Report.
Attested baseline metrics:
- Analytics request-to-insight cycle time: 21 business days current baseline. Source: Product analytics intake tracker FC-ANALYTICS-Q1FY26. Grain: request by product squad and domain. Method: submitted-to-published elapsed business days. Owner attestation: Rachel Kim.
- Data lineage completeness for customer/account/product fields: 62% current baseline. Source: data catalog lineage audit FC-LINEAGE-2026-05. Grain: field by source system and consuming report/model. Owner attestation: Rachel Kim.
- Payments/fraud signal latency: 47 minutes current baseline for selected events. Source: payments/fraud event sample FC-FRAUD-LATENCY-Q1FY26. Grain: event type by channel. Owner attestation: James Park and Kevin Walsh.
- Rework rate from disputed definitions: 14% of analytics requests reopened. Source: analytics QA/reopen tracker FC-REWORK-Q1FY26. Owner attestation: Lena Ortiz.
Stakeholder map:
- Sponsor: Priya Mehta, Chief Product Officer, Digital Banking.
- Program lead: Lena Ortiz, Director, Payments Program Management.
- Data/product analytics owner: Rachel Kim.
- Risk/compliance owner: Nadia Rahman.
- Payments owner: James Park.
- Fraud operations owner: Kevin Walsh.
- Adoption owner: servicing operations lead.
- Approver: Priya Mehta.
- Dissenter/blocker: Nadia Rahman, concerned model-risk evidence may be incomplete before charter.
Discovery recommendation:
- Proceed to P2 Synthesis with options including governance overlay, core-banking data-product layer, and hybrid product analytics operating model.
- Kill criterion: if lineage and model-risk evidence cannot be reproduced from source systems during P2, stop and return to Discovery.
Risks:
- Do not drift into core replacement execution.
- Exact financial values stay restricted.

risks: Do not drift into core replacement execution.
